figures.caption: Fig. 1 Material characterization of SU-LPSC and IN-LPSC: SEM images of the (a) IN-LPSC, and (b) SU-LPSC. (c) Typical Nyquist plots of IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC. (d) XRD patterns of IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC. (e) Raman spectra of IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC. (f) Arrhenius plots of the pellets based on IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC.

Fig. 2 Electrochemical performance of SU-LPSC cathode and IN-LPSC cathode: (a) the schematic of the ASSB structure. The planar view of the (b) IN-LPSC cathode and (c) SU-LPSC cathode under the 640 MPa pressure. (d) The rate performance of the ASSBs based on IN-LPSC cathode and SU-LPSC cathode. Charge–discharge voltage profiles of ASSBs based on IN-LPSC cathode and SU-LPSC cathode: (e) with 10 mg cm−2 cathode loading at 0.5C under room temperature; (g) with 20 mg cm−2 at 0.5C under room temperature; (i) with 10 mg cm−2 at 0.05C; the corresponding long-term cycling performances: (f), (h) and (j).

Fig. 3 Kinetics evolution of SU-LPSC and IN-LPSC cathode: the relation- ship of (a) oxidation (O1) and (b) reduction (R1) peak current of SU-LPSC and IN-LPSC cathodes versus square root of the scanning rates (n0.5). (c) CV with a scan rate of 0.1 mV s−1 based on IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC. The dQ/ dV curves of the ASSBs based on (d) IN-LPSC and (e) SU-LPSC. Nyquist plots of the ASSBs based on (f) IN-LPSC and (g) SU-LPSC. The impedance spectra are stacked with a y-axis shift of 25 O for each spectrum. Corresponding 2D intensity color map: (h) and (i).

Fig. 4 Interface contact behavior of IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC cathode: (a) cross-sectional FIB-SEM images of the composite cathodes for ASSBs based on IN-LPSC and SU-LPSC before and after cycling. Schematic diagram of SU-LPSC action mechanism: (b) and (c).

Fig. 5 Performances s of ASSBs based on SU-LPSC cathode with different cathode contents at 0.5C under room temperature (a) with 10 mg cm−2 cathode loading and (b) with 20 mg cm−2 cathode loading. (c) Rate capability performances of ASSBs with different proportions of CAM. (d) Comparison of the first cycle discharge specific capacity and capacity retention rate between the advanced ASSB.50,52–56
